body:
### What this PR does / why we need it:
Fixes #132607

In `public/app/features/logs/components/panel/grammar.ts`, the `log-token-key` rule regex was defined as:
```typescript
'log-token-key': /(\b|\B)[\w_]+(?=\s*=)/gi,
```

Because `(\b|\B)` matches at every position (both word and non-word boundaries), when a long word without an `=` is encountered, the regex engine tests the lookahead `(?=\s*=)` across all suffixes of the word repeatedly. On a 16KB unassigned string, this causes quadratic backtracking that can block the main thread for hundreds of milliseconds or seconds during Prism tokenization.

By changing `(\b|\B)` to `\b`, the regex only checks for key matches at word boundaries (which is where key tokens begin anyway, such as `key=val` or `user_id=123`).

### Benchmark Comparison
Testing against a 16,000 character string without `=`:
- Before (`(\b|\B)[\w_]+(?=\s*=)`): **~820ms**
- After (`\b[\w_]+(?=\s*=)`): **~0.16ms** (~5000x faster)

Correctness on valid key-value pairs (e.g. `foo=bar status=200 key_1="val"`) remains identical (`['foo', 'status', 'key_1']`).

### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:
Fixes #132607
title: fix(logs): remove \B alternation from key regex to prevent catastrophic backtracking
